title: Verify authenticated checkout delivery runtime
verify: Real local Medusa/PostgreSQL/backend and storefront runtime proves authenticated checkout entry, option ordering, initial 0/500/700 RUB tariffs, field rules, conditional address, optional comment, and all three payment IDs.
Acceptance proves backend normalization-before-limit behavior and sanitized field/unavailable errors using synthetic values only.
Browser recovery proves HTTP 422 delivery_method_unavailable leads to retry or explicit alternative selection without silent substitution.
Backend handoff evidence proves validated snapshot/payment-ID output and proves no order, inventory reservation, payment attempt, or payment-provider request is created by FT-006.
Evidence contains no real PII, credentials, cookies, tokens, provider payloads, session IDs, or production data.
T3 verification includes semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present before closure.

verify.reason: Upstream TASK-047 and TASK-048 are blocked; the complete FT-006 runtime cannot be exercised until their prerequisites close.
verify.operator_action: Resolve and close TASK-046, TASK-047, and TASK-048 before promoting TASK-049.

verify.reason: Direct dependencies TASK-047, TASK-048, and TASK-034 are done; the final FT-006 runtime acceptance task is executable.
verify.operator_basis: Scheduler promotion after TASK-048 closure and strict-doctor dependency reconciliation.

verify.reason: TASK-049 passed final functional and semantic T3 closure gates.
Memory Bank reconciliation completed after TASK-049 and FT-006 closure.

evidence_required: Real local backend integration output with synthetic authenticated actor and sanitized option/tariff/validation assertions.
Playwright browser trace/screenshots or equivalent for authenticated checkout and unavailable recovery.
No-order/no-payment-provider negative evidence and runtime cleanup evidence.
Privacy scan, typecheck/build/lint output, T3 semantic, human-checkpoint, and rollback/recovery evidence.
constraints: Use real local Medusa/PostgreSQL and storefront boundaries with synthetic actors/data; do not use live providers or production data.
Preserve FT-004 authenticated session/cart gate and do not bypass it with test-only auth or direct database access.
Do not create order/inventory/payment state or invoke a payment provider from FT-006 acceptance.
Keep evidence sanitized and cleanup unconditional on success or interruption.
Feature-level semantic closure remains a later owner gate after all FT-006 tasks are implemented.
invariants: Only authenticated_ready reaches the checkout form.
Configured delivery availability and tariffs are backend/Admin-owned.
Unavailable method returns 422 delivery_method_unavailable and is recoverable without silent substitution.
FT-006 validation never creates order, reservation, payment, or provider state.
No sensitive or production values appear in evidence.
purpose: Replace unit-only confidence with real authenticated backend and browser evidence for the complete FT-006 boundary.
success_outcome: The local runtime demonstrates truthful authenticated checkout delivery validation and handoff while proving no FT-006 order or payment-provider mutation and no evidence privacy breach.
anti_goals: Do not implement or verify FT-007 order/inventory behavior or FT-009 provider behavior.
Do not use live OAuth/payment/delivery providers, production secrets, or production data.
Do not bypass the storefront/backend/auth boundaries with direct database or fake-server acceptance.

forbidden_scope: production data, credentials, tokens, or secrets
stop_conditions: Real local runtime cannot exercise the authenticated storefront/backend boundary.
Acceptance requires live provider credentials, production data, or unredacted sensitive evidence.
No-order/no-payment-provider non-mutation cannot be observed credibly.
Cleanup cannot be guaranteed after success or interruption.
The implementation requires changing FT-007/FT-009 contracts or FT-004 auth behavior.
